sentences.en: My mother disapproves of too much exercise right after lunch.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈不赞成饭后立即做太多运动。

sentences.en: Some people disapprove of the education system in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 有些人反对荷兰的教育制度。

sentences.en: My father disapproved of my going to the concert.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸不同意我去听音乐会。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（不）+approve（赞成）→不赞成
